title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
hints: A linear scan is O(n) per query and the tests run thousands of queries. The array is 'almost sorted': which property of a sorted array does binary search really need?
Split at mid. At least one of the two halves, nums[lo..mid] or nums[mid..hi], is sorted in the ordinary way. Compare nums[lo] with nums[mid] to tell which.
If the left half is sorted and nums[lo] <= target < nums[mid], search it; otherwise search the right half. Mirror the logic when the right half is the sorted one.
